verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that gives AI agents tools for working with the Stripe API (docs.stripe.com/mcp), and a probe confirms it exists, so an agent can connect through it. The evidence is a single short line about the platform-wide server. Nothing shows which crypto and stablecoin operations are exposed as MCP tools. Missing for 10: evidence of crypto/stablecoin-specific MCP tool coverage, setup/auth depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
